iecc.name: Florida Building Code, Energy Conservation, 8th Edition (2023)

plumbing.name: Florida Building Code, Plumbing, 8th Edition (2023); FBC-R uses IRC P chapters for houses

elsewhere: Statewide and mandatory; 9th Edition (2026) FBC is expected to take effect Dec 31, 2026, so the 8th Edition governs in Oct 2026.
notes: FBC-R has no frost provisions and uses its own wind map; Miami-Dade and Broward are High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) with additional product approval. Florida amendments to tracked numbers not itemized.
